title: Serial-number rules of the most common network vendors in the device-type library
coverage: The eight network vendors with the most device types in the library, and APC for its UPS units. Four have a rule with a public source of the vendor's own; five have none yet, and their serials are accepted as typed.
missing: A sourced rule for HPE (Aruba), Juniper, Arista, Extreme Networks and Ubiquiti

rules.says: three characters for the place it was made, two digits for the year, two digits for the week (01 to 53), then four characters (five on some products)

source.name: Cisco Field Notice FN63942
source.quote: The SN format is LLLYYWWSSSS. The YY is the year of manufacture, and the WW is the week of manufacture.

rules.says: three characters for the factory, two digits for the year, two digits for the week (01 to 53), then five characters

source.name: Cisco: product recycling, how to read when a product was made
source.quote: the serial number code is as follows: FFFYYWWSSSSS; FFF: Factory Code; YY: Year code; WW: Week code; SSSSS: Serial number

rules.says: a Service Tag of seven letters and digits

source.name: Dell: Service Tag, Product ID Search Error, or Part Number Results (KB 000196860)
source.quote: Ensure the Service Tag is entered correctly as a 7-character alphanumeric code

rules.says: a serial that starts with FG, the abbreviation of FortiGate

source.name: Fortinet Community: Technical Tip, deciphering abbreviations for Fortinet products
source.quote: Some of these will be used as prefixes for the serial number of a product such as 'FG100Dxxxxxxxxxx'.

rules.says: a serial that starts with FS, the abbreviation of FortiSwitch

source.name: Fortinet Community: Technical Tip, deciphering abbreviations for Fortinet products
source.quote: Some of these will be used as prefixes for the serial number of a product such as 'FG100Dxxxxxxxxxx'.

rules.says: two characters, then two digits for the year and two for the week (01 to 53) the UPS was made, then the rest

source.name: Schneider Electric: APC UPS factory warranty information
source.quote: The third and fourth digits indicate the year your unit was manufactured, while the following 2 characters are the week your unit was manufactured.

vendors.no_rule_reason: No page of the vendor's own that states a format was found on the read date; a community example had nine digits, a reseller's guide said ten characters.
The vendor's hardware guides show twelve-character chassis serials as examples but state no rule; an example is not a rule.
